features.title: Feature Settings
features.subtitle: Your subscription plan decides which features are available. Enable or disable any included feature below — disabled features are hidden from the navigation and cannot be accessed. Features not in your plan are locked.
features.planManagedBody: You control which of your plan's features are turned on here. To unlock features that aren't in your plan, change your plan on the <link>Billing</link> page.

descriptions.sales: Enable sales orders, customer invoices, and sales history tracking
descriptions.accounts: Enable account management, payment tracking, and financial records
descriptions.expiryTracking: Track product expiry dates with batch management and alerts
descriptions.barcodeSystem: Enable barcode scanning and barcode-based product lookup
descriptions.invoicePrinting: Generate and print invoices for sales and purchases
descriptions.returns: Enable sales returns, purchase returns, and credit management
descriptions.uomConversion: Enable unit of measure conversion for products
descriptions.storefront: Enable a public online store with shopper accounts, online orders, and courier delivery
descriptions.tax: Enable VAT rates and apply VAT on purchases and sales
descriptions.combo: Sell several products bundled together as one priced unit

vatSettings.title: VAT
vatSettings.subtitle: Your VAT registration, BIN, and how prices and filing work
vatSettings.offTitle: VAT is not included in your plan
vatSettings.offBody: Upgrade your plan to charge VAT on sales and purchases.
vatSettings.registrationDescription: VAT registration is a legal status with a start date, not a switch. It decides whether you charge VAT and whether you can reclaim it — the rate each product carries is set in VAT Rates. Changing it never alters documents you have already issued.

standard_15.label: Standard-rated (15% regime)
standard_15.hint: You charge VAT on invoices and can reclaim VAT paid on purchases. This does not set a rate on your products — most goods are 15%, but you can still assign reduced, zero-rated or exempt rates per product in VAT Rates.

reduced.label: Reduced / truncated rate
reduced.hint: You charge VAT at a reduced rate, but cannot reclaim VAT paid on purchases — it becomes part of your product cost.

turnover_4.label: Turnover tax (4%)
turnover_4.hint: You pay 4% of turnover. Your invoices carry no VAT line at all, and you cannot reclaim input VAT.

exempt.label: Exempt
exempt.hint: Your supplies are exempt. No VAT on invoices and no input rebate.

vatSettings.effectiveFromHint: The date on your NBR registration or de-registration. Documents dated before this keep their current treatment. A month whose return has already been filed cannot be changed.
vatSettings.rebateYes: You can reclaim input VAT on purchases.
vatSettings.rebateNo: You cannot reclaim input VAT. VAT paid on purchases becomes part of your product cost.
vatSettings.binHint: Printed on every tax invoice. A registered buyer needs it to claim their rebate.
vatSettings.pricingDescription: How VAT sits inside the prices you enter.
vatSettings.pricesIncludeVatHint: Usual for retail in Bangladesh — the price on the shelf already contains VAT.
vatSettings.periodFixed: The VAT period is always one calendar month.
vatSettings.filingDayLabel: Due on day (of the following month)

confirm.title: Change your VAT registration?
confirm.split: {month} will have two VAT treatments: days {firstDay}–{lastOld} under the old registration, days {firstNew}–{lastDay} under the new one.
confirm.immutable: Documents you have already issued keep the VAT they were issued with — nothing is rewritten.
